title: Add CMO to CRO's allowed subagents

change.reason: Chris requested CMO be added to CRO's allowed subagents list so CRO can spawn CMO as a subagent for collaborative workflows (e.g., sales-marketing alignment, lead handoff coordination).

risk_assessment: Low risk. Adds CMO as a spawnable subagent for CRO. Does not remove any existing capabilities. No binding, channel, or model changes.
